subject.title: #95939 regression: bootstrapMaxChars/bootstrapTotalMaxChars deleted on every restart

question: Should `agents.defaults.bootstrapMaxChars` and `agents.defaults.bootstrapTotalMaxChars` be writable through the model-facing Gateway `config.apply`/`config.patch` tool, or should support remain limited to direct config-file edits until restart deletion is reproduced?
rationale: Current source proves a fail-closed Gateway mutation boundary still blocks the paths, but direct config persistence appears schema-backed; widening the model-to-operator boundary needs maintainer intent unless a restart repro proves that boundary is the actual writer path.

options.title: Allow only bootstrap limits
options.body: Add the two default paths, and possibly per-agent equivalents, to the Gateway allowlist with focused guard tests and no other protected-path changes.

options.title: Keep guard closed
options.body: Keep direct config-file edits as the supported path and ask for current-main restart deletion proof before changing the agent mutation boundary.

recommendation.title: Allow only bootstrap limits
recommendation.body: Add the two default paths, and possibly per-agent equivalents, to the Gateway allowlist with focused guard tests and no other protected-path changes.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent Gateway config boundary work is closest to the current allowlist decision.
